scripts.dev:all: npm --prefix functions run build && concurrently -k -n emu,web "npm:emulators" "vite"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage,auth --project demo-drops "vitest run --dir tests/rules"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm --prefix functions test
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase deploy
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-drops "node tests/e2e/two-people.mjs"
